claim_race.disposition: EARLIEST_DURABLE_CLAIM_WINS; later worker should pivot or record only explicit noncounting replication

closure.global_percent_reason: Combined Level-0 obligation denominator remains NOT_FROZEN; shard closure must not be converted into a manufactured global percentage.

high_value_findings.finding: Email evolved from context/read functionality into a broad mutating external-effect subsystem while ghostwriter/style prompts also attempted to define refusal/safety behavior. Generative style or persona prompts must never be the authority boundary for send/delete/spam/forward effects.
high_value_findings.current_transfer: Keep user intent, generation style, capability authority, confirmation and effect execution as separate layers with independently enforceable policy.

high_value_findings.finding: Remote IMAP state and local/UI replicas could diverge. k376 used optimistic hiding with rollback on failed IMAP; k375 later removed rollback while removing cards before confirmation, creating a visible-truth regression.
high_value_findings.current_transfer: Effect surfaces need explicit PENDING/COMMITTED/FAILED/ROLLED_BACK state and receipts; optimistic UI must reconcile or rollback against authoritative effect results.

high_value_findings.finding: Email reply quality and robustness improved by bounded task-specific context, explicit user-intent capture and normalization/sanitization of untrusted message content before LLM use.
high_value_findings.current_transfer: Assemble minimal task context and distinguish untrusted external content from trusted instructions and authoritative state.

high_value_findings.finding: A proactive caller assumed a nonexistent function, unsupported parameter and wrong return schema from the email module.
high_value_findings.current_transfer: Cross-module calls require machine-checkable versioned contracts/types and compatibility tests rather than convention-only assumptions.

high_value_findings.finding: Runtime components referenced a systemd service the installer did not create; native runtime dependencies were also missing until later fixes.
high_value_findings.current_transfer: Deployment manifests must close every declared service/native dependency and be validated on a clean target-like environment.

negative_results_preserved: A style/ghostwriter prompt attempted to remove refusal/safety mediation from a high-authority communication channel.
Optimistic delete/spam UI could assert disappearance before the external IMAP effect was confirmed, and a later revision removed rollback logic.
Remote IMAP and local Thunderbird mbox replicas required explicit synchronization.
Cross-service API assumptions drifted from the actual email-reader contract.
Installer/service definitions were incomplete relative to runtime references.
Native package dependencies required by QR/screenshot features were absent from installation closure.

conceptual_dedup.reason: This shard contributes historical semantic evidence and negative-result value. Row-level overlap against existing HISTORICAL_EARNED_WORK mappings was not audited in this pass, so no new avoided-hours credit is manufactured.

evidence_boundary.rule: Repository history proves historical implementation changes and regressions, not present-runtime correctness or current policy.

next_falsifiers: Replay send/delete/spam with injected transport failure and assert UI state, durable receipt and remote state converge or roll back.
Schema/type test all cross-module email calls against the actual provider contract.
Clean-install test from zero host state and verify every declared service/native dependency before startup.
Adversarial email-body test separating external content from trusted user instruction and tool authority.
